scope: All six ordinary body-flow citation keys and all thirteen frozen claim/citation pairs were checked for existence, canonical metadata, exact nearby support, relevant hypotheses, bibliography coverage, natural non-library coverage, user-library relevance, and converged LaTeX/BibTeX consistency; no priority beyond the dated bounded search is certified.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage citation-check-skill search audit followed by a bib-reference-audit consistency pass: final claims were extracted and frozen first, then verified sequentially against versioned arXiv PDFs, official publisher and Preprints records, author-hosted primary PDFs, the active user-library registry, and the final AUX/log join; no sub-agents were used because the user prohibited them.
